title: FedGraph: Defending Federated Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Against Backdoor Attacks via Graph-Based Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.18430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) allows multiple clients to collaboratively adapt models without sharing raw data, offering strong privacy benefits. However, this setting is highly vulnerable to backdoor attacks, in which malicious clients manipulate their updates to induce targeted behaviors while maintaining normal performance on benign inputs.   In this work, we make a key observation specific to federated LLM fine-tuning: malicious clients tend to exhibit strong consistency in their model updates, whereas benign clients produce more diverse and dispersed updates. This structural difference is not well captured by existing defense methods, which typically rely on direct anomaly detection in high-dimensional parameter space and therefore struggle in the presence of entangled LLM updates.   Motivated by this observation, we propose FedGraph, a graph-based aggregation framework that explicitly models relationships

translated_title: FedGraph：通过基于图的聚合方法防御联邦大语言模型微调中的后门攻击
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的联邦微调允许多个客户端在不共享原始数据的情况下协同适配模型，具有强大的隐私保护优势。然而，这种设置极易受到后门攻击，即恶意客户端操纵其模型更新以诱导特定行为，同时在良性输入上保持正常性能。在这项工作中，我们针对联邦LLM微调场景做出了一个关键观察：恶意客户端的模型更新往往表现出高度的一致性，而良性客户端则产生更加多样和分散的更新。这种结构性差异未能被现有防御方法很好地捕捉，因为现有方法通常依赖于在高维参数空间中进行直接的异常检测，因此在LLM更新相互纠缠的情况下表现不佳。基于这一观察，我们提出了FedGraph，一种基于图的聚合框架，该框架显式地建模更新之间的关系（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出FedGraph框架，利用恶意客户端更新高度一致、良性客户端更新多样分散这一结构性差异，通过基于图的聚合方法有效防御联邦大语言模型微调中的后门攻击。
en_tdlr: FedGraph is a graph-based aggregation framework that defends federated LLM fine-tuning against backdoor attacks by exploiting the structural difference that malicious clients exhibit highly consistent updates while benign clients produce diverse and dispersed updates.
